maria.ortiz: Heads up — got a report from CS that console preview for a saved dashboard template showed run names from a different workspace (acme saw globex data). Reproducible on prod. daniel.k: omg. reproduction steps? maria.ortiz: Steps: 1) open /console/workspaces/acme/dashboards/preview?tpl=xyz 2) observe left panel "Recent runs" showing globex-run-123 Also saw X-Org-ID header missing in renderer logs. ryan.s: sounds like a cache key issue. preview service caches rendered HTML by tpl id + width, but we recently removed workspace from key in https://github.com/redwood/console/commit/abc123 asha: that's the 2am refactor I landed. I thought workspace was redundant — oops. We didn't add any tests for cross-org cache invalidation. deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-19T02:15 completed for console-preview v2.3.4 maria.ortiz: urgent: this is data bleed. Can we purge CDN for templates/xyz and rollback? CS says only 3 customers affected so far but need SLA comms. daniel.k: quick mitigation: purge cdn /templates/xyz and invalidate local cache. I'll run purge now. cdn-bot: Purge request accepted: /templates/xyz, edge-popups: 12. Started. ryan.s: Also we need to ensure middleware respects X-Org header when rendering server-side. Current flow: client -> preview-service (adds org header) -> renderer (fetches saved content) but when cache hit renderer returns cached HTML without org check. asha: agreed. Fix plan: - revert my change by EOD (restore workspace->cache-key) - add unit + integration tests for cache key mapping - add safety check in renderer to bind org to cached entries - add alert if same template served to >1 org in 24h maria.ortiz: timeline? CS wants comms + purge + PR asha: I'll open PR now, will also add a one-off migration to re-key existing cache entries. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4567 daniel.k: Confirmed CDN purge completed: edge invalidation done 111s ago. cdn-bot: Purge finished: 200 OK. 12 nodes purged. ryan.s: I'll follow up with an audit script to scan cloudfront logs for requests where cookie workspace != cached-org-metadata; run it tonight and post results. maria.ortiz: thanks. tagging @security for postmortem and customer comms. security: noted — will join postmortem. Keep me posted. maria.ortiz: small note — found one log snippet where renderer returned HTML that included "data-org-id: globex" despite request header "x-org-id: acme". attaching sample: ``` GET /render?tpl=xyz x-org-id: acme --- response body starts ---
...recent-run: globex-run-123 ...
``` asha: thanks, will include that in PR description and add deterministic integration test.
